# 🆕 L46: Systemic Emergence Gate — 阻止子系统交互产生的涌现恶性螺旋
def _check_systemic_emergence(self, diagnosis, action_type) -> bool:
    emergent_patterns = self.emergent_behavior_detector.scan_for_emergent_patterns()
    active_spirals = [p for p in emergent_patterns
                      if p.predicted_end_state == "FLE_SELF_NEUTRALIZATION"]
    if active_spirals:
        self._log_rejected("L46_SYSTEMIC_EMERGENCE",
            f"{len(active_spirals)} emergent self-neutralization spirals. "
            f"Only EMERGENCY_DAMPING + NOTIFY_OWNER permitted.")
        return action_type in ("EMERGENCY_DAMPING", "NOTIFY_OWNER")
    diversity = self.model_ensemble_diversity.monitor_ensemble_diversity()
    if diversity.converged_count >= 3 and action_type in ("SELF_UPGRADE", "AUTO_EVOLVE"):
        self._log_rejected("L46_SYSTEMIC_EMERGENCE",
            f"Model ensemble convergence ({diversity.converged_count} pairs). Blocked.")
        return False
    pipeline = self.data_pipeline_backpressure.monitor_pipeline_health()
    if pipeline.critical_stage and action_type not in ("NOTIFY_OWNER", "BASELINE_HEURISTIC"):
        self._log_rejected("L46_SYSTEMIC_EMERGENCE",
            f"Pipeline backpressure at {pipeline.critical_stage}. Baseline-heuristic only.")
        return False
    return True

# 🆕 L47: Ontological Consistency Gate — 操作本体完整性
def _check_ontological_consistency(self, diagnosis, action_type) -> bool:
    if action_type in ("REPAIR", "RESTART", "ADJUST_CONFIG"):
        consistency = self.diagnostic_self_consistency.verify_diagnostic_consistency(
            diagnosis.decision_id)
        if consistency.consistency_rate < self.diagnostic_self_consistency.CONSISTENCY_ALERT_THRESHOLD:
            self._log_rejected("L47_ONTOLOGICAL_CONSISTENCY",
                f"Diagnostic consistency={consistency.consistency_rate:.0%}. Action BLOCKED.")
            return False
    kb_deps = await self._resolve_kb_dependencies_for_diagnosis(diagnosis)
    stale_deps = [d for d in kb_deps
                  if d.provenance_freshness < self.knowledge_provenance_freshness.DEPRECATION_THRESHOLD]
    if stale_deps:
        self._log_rejected("L47_ONTOLOGICAL_CONSISTENCY",
            f"{len(stale_deps)} stale KB dependencies. Action BLOCKED.")
        return False
    regression = await self.cross_version_regression.get_latest_regression()
    if regression and regression.is_critical:
        self._log_rejected("L47_ONTOLOGICAL_CONSISTENCY",
            f"Critical version regression. Only NOTIFY_OWNER + SELF_ROLLBACK.")
        return action_type in ("NOTIFY_OWNER", "SELF_ROLLBACK")
    return True

# 🆕 L48: Supply Chain Integrity Gate
def _check_supply_chain_integrity(self, diagnosis, action_type) -> bool:
    supply_chain = self.fle_self_supply_chain.scan_fle_dependencies()
    if supply_chain.critical_count > 0:
        self._log_rejected("L48_SUPPLY_CHAIN_INTEGRITY",
            f"{supply_chain.critical_count} CRITICAL vulnerabilities in FLE deps. SAFE_MODE only.")
        return action_type in ("NOTIFY_OWNER", "SELF_PATCH", "SAFE_MODE_RESTART")
    cloud_quotas = self.cloud_provider_dependency.monitor_cloud_api_quotas()
    critical_apis = [p.api_name for p in cloud_quotas.critical_apis]
    if critical_apis and action_type not in ("NOTIFY_OWNER",):
        self._log_rejected("L48_SUPPLY_CHAIN_INTEGRITY",
            f"Cloud API quotas critical. Cannot guarantee action completion.")
        return False
    model_drift = self.model_provider_drift_detector.detect_model_provider_drift()
    if model_drift.has_critical_drift and action_type not in ("NOTIFY_OWNER", "RECALIBRATE"):
        self._log_rejected("L48_SUPPLY_CHAIN_INTEGRITY",
            f"LLM provider drift detected. Actions BLOCKED until recalibration.")
        return False
    return True

# 🆕 L49: Autopoietic Resilience Gate
def _check_autopoietic_resilience(self, diagnosis, action_type) -> bool:
    permission = self.graduated_autonomy_handover.evaluate_action_permission(
        diagnosis.action, datetime.now())
    if not permission.allowed:
        if permission.requires_owner_approval:
            await self._send_owner_approval_request(diagnosis.action, permission.reason)
            self._log_rejected("L49_AUTOPOIETIC_RESILIENCE",
                f"Action requires Owner approval: {permission.reason}.")
        else:
            self._log_rejected("L49_AUTOPOIETIC_RESILIENCE", permission.reason)
        return False
    tradeoff = self.resilience_efficiency_tradeoff.model_tradeoff(diagnosis.action)
    if tradeoff.recommendation == "OWNER_DECISION":
        self._log_rejected("L49_AUTOPOIETIC_RESILIENCE",
            f"Trade-off requires Owner decision: ${tradeoff.cost.magnitude:.0f}/month.")
        return False
    cognitive_state = self.owner_cognitive_load_adapter._estimate_cognitive_state()
    if cognitive_state.fatigue_indicator == "OVERWHELMED":
        self._log_rejected("L49_AUTOPOIETIC_RESILIENCE",
            "Owner cognitive overload. Non-P1 actions deferred.")
        return action_type not in ("RESTART", "ADJUST_CONFIG", "REPAIR") or diagnosis.severity == "P1"
    return True
